∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.S →
      0 < q.ρ →
        q.ρ ≤ 1 →
          0 < q.η →
            ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
              0 ≤ Lminus →
                0 ≤ Lpm →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                    q.η ≤ 1 / (Lminus + Lpm * √((1 - q.ρ) / (q.ρ * ↑q.S))) →
                      ∀ k < q.K,
                        ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.energy q f z
                              (k + 1) ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) ≤
                          ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.energy q f z
                                k ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) -
                            q.η / 2 *
                              ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                                ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                      (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace q f z k).1‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q)

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.S →
      0 < q.ρ →
        q.ρ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
              ∀ k < q.K,
                ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.estimatorError q f z
                      (k + 1) ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) ≤
                  (1 - q.ρ) *
                      ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.estimatorError q f z
                          k ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) +
                    (1 - q.ρ) * Lpm ^ 2 / ↑q.S *
                      ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                        ‖(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace q f z (k + 1)).1 -
                              (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace q f z k).1‖ ^
                          2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q)

∀ {d : ℕ} (f : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ),
  Differentiable ℝ f →
    ∀ (L : ℝ),
      0 ≤ L →
        (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
          ∀ (x v : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (η : ℝ),
            0 < η →
              f (x - η • v) ≤
                f x - η / 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 - (1 / (2 * η) - L / 2) * ‖η • v‖ ^ 2 + η / 2 * ‖v - gradient f x‖ ^ 2

declarations.type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.S →
      0 < q.K →
        ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin q.m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
            ∀
              (O :
                OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (Fin q.m × outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d))
                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d))
              (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
              (∀ (k : ℕ),
                  O.answer 1 k (0, none) (ω k) = 0 ∧
                    ∀ (i : Fin q.m) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d),
                      O.answer 1 k (0, some (i, x)) (ω k) = gradient (f i) x) →
                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                  q.m + q.K * max q.m (2 * q.S) ≤ N →
                    OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.algorithm q) (fun x => N) seed ω =
                      outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealOutput q f
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.canonicalize q seed)

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw),
  0 < q.K →
    ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun z =>
            ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealOutput q f z)‖ ^ 2)
          ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) ∧
        ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
            ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealOutput q f z)‖ ^
              2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) =
          (↑q.K)⁻¹ *
            ∑ k,
              ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                      (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace q f z ↑k).1‖ ^
                  2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q)
